newsitem.title: USA: TCI says board oks IRS submissions.
newsitem.headline: TCI says board oks IRS submissions.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Wednesday that its board had approved the submission of a request to the Internal Revenue Service for a tax ruling concerning the tax free spin off of the company's holdings in Tele-Communications International Inc and Liberty Media Corp.

The company said the proposed spin-offs would involve the spin-off to the shareholders of Tele-Communications Inc Group common stock the shares of Tele-Communications International, and to the shareholders of Liberty Media Group common stock the shares of Liberty Media.

The final decision on whether or not to spin off the companies would be subject to ultimate board approval of the specific terms, a favorable tax ruling, receipt of a no-action letter from the Securities and Exchange Commission, and other approvals.
